summary.name: Codiga
summary.one_liner: Codiga is a customizable, real-time static code analysis tool that runs in IDEs, CI/CD pipelines and Git hosting platforms to find and fix code issues and security vulnerabilities.
use_cases: Catch security vulnerabilities while writing code in an IDE
Enforce code quality checks on pull requests
Detect leaked secrets such as API tokens and SSH keys
Write and share custom static analysis rules for a team
Check Terraform and Docker infrastructure code for issues
Track code quality metrics and violations across commits
summary.what_it_does: Codiga provides static code analysis that runs in real time inside IDEs such as VS Code, JetBrains and VisualStudio, and on GitHub, GitLab and Bitbucket. It offers rules from the Codiga Hub and lets users create, test and share their own analysis rules from the browser. It includes security rulesets covering OWASP Top 10 and SANS/CWE Top 25, detects leaked secrets, and analyzes Terraform and Docker code. It can suggest or apply automatic fixes in the IDE and can run checks in git hooks and on pull requests, with a dashboard reporting violations, duplicates and complex functions.
notable: Custom rule creation in the browser, with rules shareable on the public Codiga Hub
Security rulesets for OWASP Top 10 and SANS/CWE Top 25, plus secret detection
Real-time analysis with automated fixes inside the IDE
Supports 1800+ rules for 12+ languages according to the page
caveats: The page does not state exact pricing tiers; the 'free' label comes from the listing, not the page text
Page lists supported platforms but does not detail limits on language or CI integrations beyond the stated 12+ languages
